title: Treehouse of Horror X — Meaning, Genes, And Nothing Else #Shorts
description:
The selfish-gene reading of Treehouse of Horror X makes it less romantic and far more precise. "Treehouse of Horror X" is the fourth episode of the eleventh season of the American animated television series The Simpsons, and the tenth annual Treehouse of Horror episode, consisting of three self-contained segments. In "I Know What You Diddily-Iddily-Did", the Simpsons cover up a murder and are haunted by an unseen witness.

Behind Treehouse of Horror X sits an animal brain negotiating with a story it tells itself. On October 7, 2008, "Treehouse of Horror X" was released as part of The Simpsons: The Complete Eleventh Season DVD set. Mike Scully, George Meyer, Ian Maxtone-Graham, Ron Hauge, Donick Cary, Tim Long, Matt Selman and Pete Michels participated in the audio commentary of the episode.
